headline: Prince William And Princess Catherine Conclude India Visit With Modi
seoTitle: Prince William and Kate Conclude Earthshot Prize in Mumbai
metaDescription: Prince William and Princess Catherine have concluded their three-day tour of India, which included meetings with PM Modi and the Earthshot Prize ceremony.
aiSummaryBullets: Prince William and Princess Catherine attended the 2026 Earthshot Prize awards ceremony in Mumbai.
The Himalayan Kingdom of Bhutan and Mahindra Last Mile Mobility were among the five environmental initiative winners recognized.
During their three-day visit, the royal couple engaged in local activities including street cricket and a ride on a metro train.
aiContextParagraph: The Prince and Princess of Wales completed a three-day visit to Mumbai, India, centered around the 2026 Earthshot Prize awards ceremony. Throughout the trip, the couple participated in various public engagements, including an informal game of street cricket with local legends and a commute via a local metro system. The visit highlighted environmental efforts, with Prince William emphasizing the role of younger generations in global advocacy. The primary event concluded with the announcement of five environmental project winners, featuring international representation from the Himalayan Kingdom of Bhutan and India-based Mahindra Last Mile Mobility. Prior to the awards ceremony, the couple traveled through the city and explored local initiatives, marking a significant international focus on sustainability and climate action. The visit also included scheduled discussions regarding their broader agenda in the country.
whyItIsViral: The event received sustained coverage from three independent news outlets as the royal visit progressed from initial arrival to the final award ceremony.
